prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a young athletic man in the midst of an intense workout, captured from a low, slightly off-center angle that emphasizes his determination and focus. He is wearing a dark, sleeveless athletic tank top that reveals his muscular arms and shoulders, glistening with sweat. His short, dark hair is slightly tousled, and he has a neatly trimmed beard. The man’s expression is one of concentration and exertion, with his eyes looking forward and a slight, determined smile on his face. The background is softly blurred, suggesting an indoor gym or workout space with cool, neutral tones and minimal distractions. The lighting is natural and soft, casting gentle highlights on his skin and creating a sense of depth and realism. The overall color palette is muted, with cool blues and grays dominating the scene, and the shallow depth of field draws all attention to the subject’s face and upper body, capturing the raw energy and focus of the moment.
